names.title: Names to screen
names.description: Person, company or vessel names (Ukrainian, Russian or Latin script).

ids.title: IDs to screen (optional)
ids.description: Exact ID lookup: tax numbers, registration numbers (EDRPOU, OGRN, INN), passport numbers, IMO/MMSI.

fuzzyThreshold.title: Fuzzy threshold
fuzzyThreshold.description: Minimum name similarity, 0-1 (default 0.85). Lower = more potential matches.

activeOnly.title: Active sanctions only
activeOnly.description: Hide subjects whose sanctions were lifted or expired (they are shown with status by default)

maxMatchesPerName.title: Max matches per name
maxMatchesPerName.description: Cap on matches returned per screened name
